chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"It is from the sunnah (prophetic tradition) that when people go out on a journey, they bring out their expenses together, for that is more pleasant for their souls and better for their character."

key_terms.أَطْيَبُ: more agreeable, more wholesome, and more soothing
key_terms.نَفَقَتَهُمْ: their travel expenses or spending provisions
key_terms.ٱلسُّنَّةِ: the normative prophetic tradition and practice

ai.seo_question: What does the sunnah (prophetic tradition) teach about sharing travel expenses?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that shared financial contribution during travel is from the sunnah (prophetic tradition). It emphasizes that pooling expenses promotes emotional ease and refines the manners and character of the travelers.
